subject: 9mmhandgun
label: 9mmhandgun, in the place of the game's models/v_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/p_9mmhandgun.mdl, models/w_9mmhandgun.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_grenade.mdl, models/w_satchel.mdl, models/w_357.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked A, D, A, D where the asset was B, D, A, B: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Every view reads as a semi-automatic pistol lying on its side, as the brief asks: a long slide (Top, Right, Below), a grip angled off its rear end (Top, Below, Front-Left, Back-Left), and a trigger-guard hook (Top and Below). Blocky, with a flat slab-like slide in Front and Back, but no part sticks out or is missing, and the form is right.

M2.reason: Measured length is 9.8 against the brief's 10, 2.2% off, well within 15%. Width 1.5 and height 9 are the measured extents, and the brief gives no other size.

M3.reason: Visible: slide with an ejection port, a grip, a trigger guard loop (top and below views), and small sight marks at the slide ends. Not clearly there at this size: the trigger is not visible inside the guard in any view, and the magazine base is not distinct from the grip block. A small part not clearly there caps M3 at 1.

M4.reason: Dark, almost black polymer frame and grip with a grey steel slide and highlights, as the brief asks: black and grey polymer and steel.

M5.reason: The brief asks for no markings. The ejection port and sight marks are there, and no stray detail is added.

M6.reason: Line-up measure: asset at B, judge picked A (passed); asset at D, judge picked D (caught); asset at A, judge picked A (caught); asset at B, judge picked D (passed). Caught on two of four readings, so the amendment caps M6 at 1. Note: the brief to score M6 as 2 conflicts with this measure, and I followed the measure, which says never higher.

M7.reason: Lies on its side on the floor as the brief asks: the thin axis is vertical (about 1.4 units in the front and left views). The muzzle direction is not stated by the brief.

M8.reason: SMAK checks clean (no check errors). 112 triangles against a median of 142 for Half-Life's props of its kind and size, far below twice. No open or floating faces show in the views; the dark ejection port is a hole a player sees, and is a recess rather than an open shell.

W1.reason: In the first-person view the gun sits where Valve's does: same hand, same way round, slide up and left, and the grip sits in the glove. Across the attack frames (0 to 14 of 14) the gun shifts up slightly on recoil and returns, with the hand and gun staying together. It does not leave the hands.
